verdict.rationale: Synctera documents API keys, internal transfers, wires, ACH and balance retrieval. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped credentials restricted to reading balances and initiating transfers, per-credential amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or any vendor-named agent use case. The admin team-access controls in the learning center cover human team permissions, which is an adjacent feature, not policy-bound agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
